dct_description_sm: Country Residential Subdivision boundaries within Durham Region created for the Regional Official Plan. ROP Consolidation September 3, 2024.History:Dataset originally imported from DetailedGeographies.mdb,       on November 14th, 2018. This was completed for time-stamped purposes, as the original dataset can still be subject to change throughout the MCR process. Updates were made in January 2019 based on Area Municipality review/comments. Further cartographic updates were made throughout the MCR process, to ensure boundaries are accurate and consistent throughout the Region.
